name: clickguard
description: ClickGuard Threat Monitoring — React prototype + @clickguard/ui design system

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:app
scripts.build:storybook: npm run build:ui && npm run build-storybook --workspace @clickguard/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build:ui && npm run dev --workspace @clickguard/prototype
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @clickguard/ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @clickguard/prototype
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check:data
